Title: Generally Available: Azure Site Recovery update rollup 75 – August 2024

Body.Content:
This update provides the following improvements for the latest version of Azure Site Recovery components.

Mobility Service –

Added support for Linux OS for:

  • Azure to Azure – No new releases.
  • Modernized VMware/Physical to Azure - No new releases.

Learn more about the issues fixed and get the download links.
